Definition: properly, tightly girt, i.e. probably a racer, or some fleet animal (as being slender in the waist)
BiblicalUsage: 1) girded, girt, alert, used with H04975 in Pr 30:31; 1a) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown
